.ci-artifacts/.purpose: unsigned CI observations and reports; the producing lane regenerates them

.jankurai/.purpose: gitignored audit lane output; the audit lane regenerates it from the pinned local auditor

.storybook/.purpose: Storybook state coverage for the rendered status header

CHANGELOG.md.purpose: release language must stay evidence-backed and honestly blocked; the audit lane checks it

CLAUDE.md.purpose: thin Claude adapter that only points at AGENTS.md

scripts/.purpose: local CI entrypoints that delegate to the same ops/ci scripts hosted jobs call

test-results/.purpose: Playwright screenshot and trace receipts; the contract lane regenerates them

tools/.purpose: canonical security-lane wrapper that execs ops/ci/security.sh

contracts/.purpose: projection contract boundary; the contract lane proves generated clients

schemas/.purpose: shape of local Jankurai score artifacts written by the audit lane

tests/.purpose: Linux pidfd component supervisor and its acceptance inventory

tokens/.purpose: semantic design tokens consumed by the rendered surfaces

src/.purpose: prove observation rendering and Control Tower state

.github/.purpose: prove hosted lanes match local scripts

ci.toml.purpose: prove prepared Jeryu jobs preserve the local lane boundary and remain activation-blocked

docs/.purpose: validate local links and CI truth claims

README.md.purpose: documentation; the fast lane proves the commands it names

AGENTS.md.purpose: agent entrypoint; the fast lane proves the commands it names

SPLIT.md.purpose: split-family contract; the required lane is the check it names

Justfile.purpose: command surface; CI recipes delegate to scripts/ci-local.sh and the score recipe runs the local auditor

.gitignore.purpose: exclusion list for generated and local outputs; the fast lane proves the tree still builds

.gitleaksignore.purpose: prove the exact historical false-positive fingerprint while the current-tree scan and secret canary remain load-bearing

agent/.purpose: Jankurai metadata; the audit lane validates it
